answer: In PoA, correlated equivocation links identities through conflicting signatures on the same history. For k coordinated identities, aggregate slashing scales as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Bonded escrows make the penalty enforceable, while asymmetric capital depreciation means detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss. The labels lagoon, basalt, and karst do not change the rule.
